name: Apex Legends
native_kbm_note: The PS5 version has no native keyboard/mouse support. EA's controls help page lists only controller defaults for PlayStation, and many EA forum threads ask for native PS5 KBM support (e.g. forums.ea.com/discussions/apex-legends-feedback-en/add-keyboard--mouse-support-on-ps5/12417891).
notes: EA's page lists PC ping as 'R1'; the real PC default is middle mouse (MOUSE3). Weapon slots 1/2 have no direct PS5 equivalent (Triangle tap cycles weapons), so both map to Triangle. Holster (3) is a Triangle hold. Interact (E) and reload (R) are both Square on PS5. Fire select (B -> D-pad Left) comes from memory of the PS5 default and isn't in EA's table. ESC is a secondary for Options, which opens inventory/menu on PS5. Health item (4) is a D-pad Up tap; holding it opens the health wheel.
